The sunlit-vs-shadowed gap is structural, not a data gap. Replaced by A16 (W1).

items.title: Re-cut PSR70/170/183 floors from Bertone et al. 2026 SfS 5 m topography and test whether small-crater structure LOLA smoothed out changes the shadowed-floor geometry
items.note: ANSWERED NEGATIVELY, and not by re-running: SfS cannot constrain the PSR70 floor because photoclinometry needs light. GLDMASK shows the floor is seen by ZERO illuminated NAC images on 99.6% of its pixels (median 0) against a median of 26 off-floor. |SDEM-LDEM| scales with image count: 0.13 m at 0 images, 0.43-0.59 m at 1+. Floor sd is 0.251 m vs 0.935 m over the crop, and >1 m differences occur on 0.79% of floor vs 22.5% of crop. The floor stays LOLA-derived, so the small-crater question is unanswerable with this product and needs a different sensor.

items.title: Tier-2 thermal-solve cost: 120 m facets project to 124 h (T2) / 259 h (T1) against a 36 h wall. Need the real --tsteps-day floor for a shadowed polar floor before I resize
items.note: ANSWERED BY MEASUREMENT, not by CC. Thermal solve scales N^1.61 (measured, 3 local meshes), so T2=250h / T1=817h at 16000x6 - worse than the 124/259 I projected linearly. Radiosity is NOT the bottleneck (dense matvec 1.53 ms at 6272 facets = 0.04 h over a full run) and sparsifying FAILS (matrix 43.6% dense; 1e-6 keeps 97.4% energy but sparse matvec is slower; 1e-5 keeps 51.8%). Cost is per-facet RTE/spectral at ~450 us/facet/step. Practical fix: 240 m facets = 1568 facets = exactly 1:1 with a Diviner pixel = 27.8 h LOCALLY, no cluster.
